correctness.rationale: For a subset D of the m-by-n rook board, ordinary rook domination is equivalent to every row occupied or every column occupied; complement-total domination is equivalent to no row-column cross containing all D. For all occupied rows a>=3, exact cross-failure classification subtracts b z^a and ab z^(a-1)(U_b-z), whereas a=2 requires >=2 cells per row; full both-row-column coverage is E via inclusion-exclusion, with deficient cross-overlap mn z^(m+n-2)(1+z) except degenerate 2x2. Therefore the asserted F formula is correct. Sharp lower bound min(m,n) and cross obstruction lead to min=4 for m=2 and =m for m>=3; minimizing placement counts n^m-n-mn(n-1) or 2[...]-m! in square case follow by exact outlier/pigeonhole classification. Independent direct adjacency-mask brute force matched every coefficient and all minimum sets on 7 boards through 4x4 (71,504 subsets total), independent of the all-size combinatorial proof.
residual_risks: The fully supplied source-tree listing and exact tree recomputation are not exposed by the connected GitHub fetch_file read action; per-file frozen Git blob SHA identities are verified.
